title: KHP07 10-round AES-192 / aes192-10r-rectangle-256-key-khp2007

target.description: 10 nonlinear AES rounds with the initial whitening addition and no final MixColumns. The recovered material is specified below.Output: whitening bytes 1,2,6,7,8,11,12,13 plus last-round K9 bytes 0,7,8,10,12,13; unknown key differences d,e,f are additionally enumerated. These are fourteen subkey bytes, not a recovered 192-bit master key.
